title: Blog Launch Checklist
description: Launch a new WordPress blog — categories, RSS, comments, author pages, and first posts.

steps.title: Set Blog Posts on Homepage
steps.instructions: Choose 'Your latest posts' or assign a static front page with a separate Posts page under Settings → Reading.

steps.title: Create Core Categories
steps.instructions: Define 3–8 clear categories that match your content plan. Avoid a single 'Uncategorized' catch-all.

steps.title: Complete Author Profiles
steps.instructions: Add display name, bio, and avatar for each author under Users → Profile. Link author archives if the theme supports them.

steps.title: Verify RSS Feed
steps.instructions: Open /feed/ in a browser or reader. Confirm titles, excerpts, and featured images appear correctly.

steps.title: Set Comment Moderation Rules
steps.instructions: Enable moderation for first-time commenters. Install anti-spam (Akismet or similar) before publishing.

steps.title: Publish 3–5 Starter Posts
steps.instructions: Launch with enough content that visitors see a living blog—not a single Hello World. Schedule the next posts if ready.

steps.title: Add Subscribe or Newsletter CTA
steps.instructions: Place an email signup or RSS prompt in sidebar, footer, or end-of-post. Connect to your newsletter tool if used.

steps.title: Enable Social Sharing
steps.instructions: Add share buttons or Open Graph tags so posts preview well on social networks when readers share them.
